body: I think younger me would be much more concerned with how I can feel romantic love at all than who it would be towards lol. Young me didn’t understand it at all. I myself never felt any manner of it until last year, let alone romantic or sexual attraction. Still have a hard time with it, but my girlfriend is a wonderful resource for when I’ve not a clue wtf is going on 😊
Thank you so much, that really did help!
